entries.heading: Verse 1
entries.text: Ps 36:1-12 . On servant of the Lord, see on Ps 18:1 , title. The wickedness of man contrasted with the excellency of God's perfections and dispensations; and the benefit of the latter sought, and the evils of the former deprecated.

2-4. This reflection detailed. until his iniquity --literally, "for finding his iniquity for hating"; that is, he persuades himself God will not so find it--"for hating" involving the idea of punishing. Hence his words of iniquity and deceit, and his bold rejection of all right principles of conduct. The climax is that he deliberately adopts and patronizes evil. The negative forms affirm more emphatically their contraries.

entries.heading: 5, 6. mercy . . . and . . . faithfulness
entries.text: 5, 6. mercy . . . and . . . faithfulness --as mercy and truth ( Ps 25:10 ).

entries.heading: 6. righteousness
entries.text: 6. righteousness [and] judgments --qualities of a good government ( Ps 5:8; 31:1 ). These all are set forth, by the figures used, as unbounded.

entries.heading: 7. shadow of thy wings
entries.text: 7. shadow of thy wings --(Compare De 32:11; Ps 91:1 ).

entries.heading: 8. fatness
entries.text: 8. fatness --richness. thy house --residence--for the privileges and blessings of communion with God ( Ps 23:6; 27:4 ). river of thy pleasures --plenteous supply; may allude to Eden.
9. Light is an emblem of all blessings, given of God as a means to gain more.

entries.heading: 10. that know thee
entries.text: 10. that know thee --right knowledge of God is the source of right affections and conduct.

entries.heading: 11. foot of . . . hand . . . wicked
entries.text: 11. foot of . . . hand . . . wicked --all kinds of violent dealing.

entries.heading: 12. There
entries.text: 12. There --in the acting of violence, they are overthrown. A signal defeat.
